comparison.name: comparison
comparison.scope: Fixed geometry/orbit/technology; searched installed suction capacity, cutoff, and optional closure time

search.method: coarse paired grid + two bounded coordinate passes

open.status: Conditional continuous-boundary study; leakage coefficients and pump envelope unvalidated

unresolved: Inlet capture/unstart/pressure recovery calibration and shock position
Real compressor map and mass capability over the inlet/backing pressure range
Closed/open external pressure drag, heat protection and actuation mechanism
Gas-solid conductance, temperature transients and deployment engineering
Finite-thrust orbit restoration and circular-apogee delivery

numerics.solver: LSODA, relative tolerance 2e-8; adaptive plus uniform quadrature samples
